report.title: How many parallel researchers before returns diminish, and what is the evidence?
report.question_or_target: What published or locally measurable evidence exists for the marginal yield of the Nth parallel researcher on one question - distinct claims added, contradiction coverage, cost - and where does the curve flatten for the two run shapes we use (broad landscape scan versus targeted question)?
report.answer_summary: No universal N. Local marker arithmetic is reproducible on this tree (targeted algorithmic flatten_n=2 at prefix-overlap median 0.595; broad flatten_n=5), but those cutoffs are REFUTED as SAME-full-prompt evidence. Heading/bullet claim unions do not flatten through the observed N. Published compute-matched studies favor diversity and topology over raw headcount; More Agents is counterevidence to an early universal plateau.
